plugins.name: implement-feature
plugins.description: Interview-driven, test-first, human-in-the-loop workflow that builds a Python feature via a conductor plus isolated model-pinned subagent gates. Release channel: pinned to a tag; `release.sh` moves the pin. See ADR-13.

plugins.name: implement-feature-dev
plugins.description: DEV channel of implement-feature (same plugin folder, loaded in place / live). Enabled only by the dev container — not for end users. See ADR-13.

plugins.name: toy-greet
plugins.description: Toy 2-gate greeting workflow — a learning scaffold for plugin/command mechanics.
